command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; Write-Output ('FREDWIN_HOST=' + $env:COMPUTERNAME); $remote=@'
cd /home/ubuntu/mei-mg-email || exit 2
echo CHECK_BRT=$(TZ=America/Sao_Paulo date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z)
sudo docker exec mei-mg-email-db psql -X -U postgres -d mei_mg_email -At -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "set statement_timeout='30s'; select 'RAW_INDEPENDENT_POOL='||count(*) from mei_email.empresas e where e.tipo_regime='MEI' and e.uf='MG' and e.situacao_cadastral='ATIVA' and e.opt_out=false and e.provavel_terceiro=false and e.email is not null and e.enviado=false and e.marketing_autorizado=true and e.mei_verificado=true and mei_email.is_independent_marketing_authorization(e.marketing_autorizado,e.marketing_autorizado_origem) and btrim(coalesce(e.marketing_autorizado_origem,'')) not in ('confirmacao_operador_2026-08-12','confirmacao_operador_2026-08-13','politica_importacao_operador_2026-08-13','user_explicit_authorization_2026-08-20','user_campaign_authorization_2026-08-20') and lower(btrim(coalesce(e.marketing_autorizado_origem,''))) not like '%operator_authorization_true%' and mei_email.is_independent_mei_verification(e.mei_verificado,e.mei_verificado_origem) and btrim(coalesce(e.mei_verificado_origem,'')) not in ('override_operador_2026-08-13','politica_importacao_operador_2026-08-13'); select 'SUPPRESSION_INDEX='||case when to_regclass('mei_email.idx_email_suppressions_lookup') is null then 'missing' else 'present' end; select 'FLYWAY_37_38='||count(*) from mei_email.flyway_schema_history where version in ('37','38') and success;"
printf WORKER=; sudo systemctl is-active mei-mg-email-worker.service || true
printf ENABLED=; sudo systemctl is-enabled mei-mg-email-worker.service || true
sudo test -f /var/lib/mei-mg-email/sender_blocked.pause && echo SENTINEL=present || echo SENTINEL=absent
'@; & ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=15 shopvivaliz-vm $remote; $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('SSH_RC=' + $rc); exit 0
reason: Read-only indexed upper-bound proof of independently authorized MEI pool plus suppression-index and Flyway 37/38 ledger presence. No data, service, consent, suppression or sender-block mutation.
